sources.name: Archiset performance-data enriched floorplan dataset
notes: Archiset download UI explicitly states CC BY 4.0 for the dataset.
IFC ZIP parts are treated as original dataset artifacts, not converted derivatives.
Candidate scans use ZIP Range extraction to avoid downloading multi-GB archives wholesale.

sources.name: ThatOpen engine_web-ifc public test models
notes: Repository package metadata and LICENSE.md declare MPL-2.0 for the software repository.
Repository-level software licensing is not assumed to grant independent model-level training or redistribution rights.
Issue-labelled files are retained in the candidate pool when they are complete non-single-component IFC2X3 models; purpose is classified separately.

sources.name: buildingSMART Community Sample Test Files
notes: README states contributed files are published under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.
README also states most samples may not pass validation; technical admission therefore requires local parse/traversal/write/reopen certification.

sources.name: BIMData Research & Development IFC Files index
notes: BIMData is discovery-only. The index name, reported size and source URL are not treated as file-level truth until the upstream package/file is verified.
Candidate source evidence is resolved to DURAARK/TIB, Open IFC Model Repository, BIMcollab, NIBS or other upstream sources where possible.

sources.name: DURAARK Public Building Data
notes: Package URLs and package SHA256 values are recorded in acquisition-duraark-bimdata-overlap.jsonl for acquired families.
BIMData index metadata never overrides package-level observations.

sources.name: IFC-Bench V2
notes: IFC-Bench LICENSE applies CC BY 4.0 to benchmark questions, documentation, model cards and original benchmark content.
IFC model files retain their original per-project licenses.
V2 currently has 29/31 referenced model pairs locally; sixty5/arc and sixty5/plumbing are excluded as explicit very-large-file exceptions.
